subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should WhatsApp treat an unlisted group JID as an opt-in auto-leave condition with a private owner notification, while keeping sender allowlist denials non-destructive and deferring generic group pairing to the broader proposal?
rationale: Current behavior deliberately separates group membership admission from sender authorization, and the requested departure, notification, and tool surfaces define durable security and user-facing contracts that source inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Narrow WhatsApp membership action
options.body: Add an opt-in WhatsApp-only action for group JIDs rejected by `channels.whatsapp.groups`, with a private redacted owner event; keep `groupAllowFrom` denials as message-only blocks and leave generic pairing to the broader issue.

options.title: Design one cross-channel pairing contract
options.body: Pause this channel-specific feature until the group-pairing design defines shared approval, notification, storage, and optional-leave semantics for all channels.

options.title: Retain drop-only behavior
options.body: Keep the current drop-and-diagnostic posture and document it as the intended privacy boundary, without adding automatic departure or agent-controlled group actions.

recommendation.title: Narrow WhatsApp membership action
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in WhatsApp-only action for group JIDs rejected by `channels.whatsapp.groups`, with a private redacted owner event; keep `groupAllowFrom` denials as message-only blocks and leave generic pairing to the broader issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing maintainer-side review and adjacent WhatsApp runtime/docs history make steipete the strongest available owner for the product-boundary choice.
